mistake_reason: The orchestrator instructed WebSurfer to open and analyze a local Excel file path, which WebSurfer cannot access. This inappropriate tool selection led the team to rely on web-based reconstruction rather than using FileSurfer to read the attachment. Consequently, the team produced a guessed sequential mapping (1,2,3,4,5,6) instead of analyzing the file contents, causing the wrong final answer. This matches FM-4.3: Tool Selection Error.
